detailed_descriptions_html.en:
TRADE

Buy, sell, short stocks online. In full screen or placed in the corner of your desktop while you take care of other things.

BUY STOCKS

Various stocks are available for you to make your gains (or losses). Gain access to new stocks along the way and find those best suit your strategy.

UPGRADE

Buy more stocks, receive more from dividends, increase your base income. Level up to gain bonuses such as auto-actions and higher offline returns.

Features

  • Online multiplayer clicker stock trader

  • Level up to unlock new stocks and abilities

  • Upgrade your income, dividends, and stock volume

  • Prestige by Going Public

  • Can be played in full screen or in the corner of your dekstop

  • Tons of skins
